## Editor's Brief

The past 24 hours have seen a dramatic escalation in the US-Iran conflict despite a recently signed peace memorandum, with US forces striking Iranian missile, drone, and radar sites after an attack on a commercial vessel in the Strait of Hormuz. Simultaneously, a landmark US-brokered framework agreement between Israel and Lebanon offers a potential diplomatic breakthrough in the Middle East. In the Indo-Pacific, RIMPAC 2026 begins with 30 nations, while China's military activities in the Pacific draw warnings from New Zealand. Ukraine unveils a massive new underwater drone, and South Korea plans to train half a million troops for drone warfare—underscoring the accelerating global shift toward unmanned systems.
